title: Stealthy-Currency
description: A performance-friendly physical currency and economy plugin for Minecraft servers.
body:
# Stealthy-Economy

Stealthy-Economy is a Minecraft economy plugin built around physical coins, item values, and server-friendly economy tracking.

It is designed for survival, roleplay, factions, events, and civilisation-style servers where money should feel like part of the world rather than just a number in a balance command.

## Features

- Physical coin economy with copper, silver, gold, and platinum pieces
- Custom coin texture support through a server resource pack
- Item worth checking with `/worth hand`
- Container and inventory appraisal tools
- Dynamic supply-based pricing for scarce or surplus resources
- Mount appraisal for horses, donkeys, mules, camels, llamas, and similar mounts
- Readable mount stats, including health, speed, and jump height
- Vanilla item fallback values for common blocks, tools, resources, Nether items, End items, and crafted items
- BreweryX drink value support
- Admin-friendly commands for checking supply, item values, coins, and resource pack setup
- Performance-conscious scanning for larger servers

## Designed for larger servers

The plugin avoids constant full-world scanning. Supply tracking can use cached data, touched containers, online player inventories, offline player snapshots, and manual full scans when needed.

This makes it more suitable for event servers and larger communities where economy tracking needs to be useful without hammering server performance.

## Resource pack support

Stealthy-Economy can use a resource pack for custom coin icons. The pack supports custom textures for:

- Copper coins
- Silver coins
- Gold coins
- Platinum coins
